title: JournalEntry
description: One price change, ever, from any source — including changes made by hand in the Shopify admin (R18). Shopify keeps no price audit trail; this is it. Append-only: entries are never updated or deleted, and the `before_*` values are what makes every change reversible.

title.description: Denormalised for the CSV export and for entries whose variant was later deleted.

source.description: external = detected via products/update, i.e. somebody changed the price outside Priceflag. Those pause any rollout touching the variant (R4).

actor.description: Who caused it. `shopify_admin` means the change arrived from outside and we only observed it.

reason.description: Plain language, e.g. 'Stage 2 of Spring margin repair (50% of selection).'

status.description: skipped_noop = the price already equalled the target, so nothing was written. Compare-before-write idempotency makes this common and it is not an error.

error.description: Present when status=failed: the Shopify userError or transport failure, verbatim.
